en.topic_title: Hong Kong court acquits gov’t statistician who followed, photographed girl during school open day
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong magistrate has acquitted a government statistician of a loitering offence, despite describing his behaviour of following and photographing a schoolgirl during an open day last year as “highly suspicious.”



Eastern Magistrates’ Courts. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP.



Patrick Lam, a statistician with the Census and Statistics Department, was cleared of a charge of “loitering causing concern” at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday.
